<!-- Write the title and body in English. Follow the development flow and language convention:
https://github.com/takahirox/three-motionbricks/blob/main/docs/development-flow.md#collaboration-language
-->

## Problem

Describe the problem and who or what it affects.

## Expected outcome

Describe what should be true when this Issue is resolved.

## Context and reproduction

Include relevant discussion, examples, logs or related Issues. For reproducible
problems, provide steps, expected results and actual results. State when
reproduction does not apply.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

List mandatory implementation requirements and checks achievable and verifiable
before merge. Default to criteria an AI implementer can execute and verify.
Require human input, subjective review, physical hardware or external approval
only when necessary for this Issue; explain why and what result is needed.

- [ ] Replace with a concrete, verifiable completion criterion.

## Optional validation

List useful additional checks separately from mandatory criteria, or state
"None required."

## Required post-merge verification

List genuinely necessary checks possible only after merge, or state
"None required." Keep these pending until performed. A merge-triggered deployment
or publication cannot be a pre-merge prerequisite; pre-merge test results do not
establish deployment success. See the
[review and merge guidelines](https://github.com/takahirox/three-motionbricks/blob/main/docs/review-guidelines.md).
